headline: BharatRohan unit seeks $5M private placement
summary: BharatRohan Airborne Innovations discloses that its step-down subsidiary, BharatRohan INC, is pursuing a $5 million fund raise via private placement in the US.

headline: Rentomojo Q2FY27 Results: Net profit falls 62% YoY
summary: Rentomojo Limited reported a net profit of ₹181.93 million for Q2FY27, down 62% YoY. Revenue rose 53% to ₹1,421.13 million, driven by rental growth.

headline: BHEL wins ₹600-900 crore Power Grid order
summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals wins a ₹600-900 crore order from Power Grid for two synchronous condensers at the Barmer-II HVDC station.

headline: UBS maintains Buy on Britannia, cuts target to ₹5800
summary: UBS reaffirms Buy rating on Britannia Industries with a revised target price of ₹5,800, citing 11% H1 volume growth and resilient demand, even as margin recovery is deferred to FY28.

headline: Bombay HC stays closure notice for CG Power's Waluj plant
summary: The Bombay High Court stayed the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board's closure notice for CG Power's Waluj facility. Citi maintains a Buy rating with a target price of ₹1100.

headline: Hindalco Q2FY27 EBITDA up 43% YoY
summary: UBS maintains Buy on Hindalco Industries after Q2FY27 EBITDA rose 43% YoY to ₹128 billion, driven by aluminium realisations and Novelis performance.

headline: JSW Steel crude output up 19% in Oct 2026
summary: JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 25.73 lakh tonnes for October 2026, marking a 19% year-on-year growth driven by strong Indian operations.

headline: HEGAM subsidiary TACC secures ₹609.50 crore ECMS incentive
summary: TACC Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of HEG Advanced Materials, received approval for a ₹609.50 crore incentive under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme for its synthetic graphite anode project in Dewas.

headline: Government eyes mandatory pulse stock disclosure
summary: The government may mandate stock disclosure of pulses amid a sharp rise in prices, signalling a potential regulatory move to improve supply-side transparency.

headline: India 10-year bond yield rises to 7.1678%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield moved up to 7.1678% from the previous close of 7.1529%, reflecting a marginal rise in yields.

headline: Sugar mills face margin pressure in FY27
summary: Crisil warns sugar mills face margin pressure in FY27 due to rising input costs and limited pricing power, signalling stress for the sector.

headline: Max Estates targets ₹1,000 crore commercial revenue
summary: Max Estates has set a target of ₹1,000 crore in revenue from its commercial real estate business, signalling a major growth push in the segment.

headline: Rupee opens at 93.72 vs dollar, stronger than prior close
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 93.72 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 93.9275, reflecting a firmer start in early trade.

headline: Quick commerce fuels D2C festive sales growth
summary: Quick commerce platforms drove strong festive season sales for D2C brands, with premium gifting and considered purchases helping offset broader consumer spending pressures.

headline: Elitecon International signs exclusive distribution deal
summary: Elitecon International has signed an exclusive distribution agreement with Star Herb Pharma for distribution rights in India, marking a significant business development for the company.

headline: Fujiyama Power to update guidance post-Q3
summary: Fujiyama Power Systems plans to revise its guidance after Q3 results due to market shifts like ALMM 2 and DCR cell shortages. The company maintains EBITDA margin expectations of 18-19%.

headline: Dabur India shuts Atlanta Body and Health Products unit
summary: Dabur India has closed its subsidiary Atlanta Body and Health Products through voluntary liquidation, marking a structured wind-down of the unit.

headline: Jyoti Structures mobilizes bank guarantees under NCLT plan
summary: Jyoti Structures has mobilized bank guarantees and letters of credit to strengthen its order book, supported by a release of ₹510.59 crore under its NCLT approved resolution plan.

headline: Reliance Industries BSE block trade of ₹100.02 crore
summary: A block trade of approximately 750,000 shares of Reliance Industries was executed on BSE at ₹1,333.60 per share, amounting to ₹100.02 crore.

headline: Govt bans export of battery waste and black mass
summary: The government has banned the export of battery waste, scrap, and lithium-ion battery black mass with immediate effect, tightening controls on critical battery materials.

headline: Cyient shares see large trade at ₹1,113.50
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 375,289 Cyient shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,113.50, with a combined value of ₹41.79 crore.

headline: Sai Life Sciences targets 15-18% revenue CAGR
summary: Sai Life Sciences has issued medium-term guidance of 15-18% revenue CAGR with EBITDA margins in the 28-30% range, signalling its growth and profitability outlook.

headline: Tata Power to host investor meets in Mumbai
summary: Tata Power will participate in three institutional investor conferences in Mumbai from November 16 to 18, 2026, engaging with analysts and investors.

headline: Power Grid sees ₹55.14 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 2,096,313 shares of Power Grid Corporation was executed on BSE at ₹263.05 per share, totalling ₹55.14 crore.

headline: JSW Steel releases November 2026 investor presentation
summary: JSW Steel Limited uploaded a new investor presentation to its website on November 11, 2026. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Adani Energy Solutions sees ₹118.37 crore block trade
summary: A block trade of approximately 809,560 shares of Adani Energy Solutions was executed on the NSE at ₹1,462.20 per share, totalling ₹118.37 crore.

headline: Angel One to host investor meetings in Nov 2026
summary: Angel One Limited will engage with analysts and institutional investors at two physical conferences in Mumbai on November 18 and 26, 2026, discussing publicly available data.

headline: ideaForge Q2FY27: PAT turns positive, revenue up 124%
summary: ideaForge Technology reported a return to profitability with ₹6.5 crore PAT in Q2FY27. Revenue rose 124% YoY to ₹91.3 crore, driven by strong defense deliveries and improved margins.

headline: IndiGo shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~82,076 IndiGo shares changing hands on BSE at ₹5,663.15, with a combined value of ₹46.48 crore.

headline: Ambuja Cements to host investor meet Nov 16
summary: Ambuja Cements will interact with investors and analysts at the JM Financial Investor Conference in Mumbai on November 16, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on public data.

headline: Concord Control Systems H1FY27 revenue up ~95% YoY
summary: Concord Control Systems reported H1FY27 revenue of ~₹159 crore, up ~95% YoY, with EBITDA rising ~110% to ₹46.7 crore and net profit up ~95% to ₹31.2 crore.

headline: Bharti Airtel shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,00,026 Bharti Airtel shares changing hands on BSE at ₹2100.00, with a combined value of ₹21.01 crore.

headline: Loyal Textile promoter seeks public reclassification
summary: Palaniappan Manivannan sold 2 shares for ₹411 and requested reclassification from promoter to public category under SEBI Regulation 31A.

headline: Graphite India to attend 360 ONE Capital Conference
summary: Graphite India Ltd senior management will participate in the 360 ONE Capital Conference in Singapore on November 16-17, 2026. The company will present its Q2 FY27 earnings.

headline: IntellectAI launches AI portfolio steering app for insurers
summary: Intellect Design Arena's Insurtech unit launches Xponent Portfolio Navigator, an AI tool enabling insurers to steer entire books and act on drift instantly.

headline: Radico Khaitan unveils Rampur brand positioning
summary: Radico Khaitan launches '43° | 2°' for Rampur Single Malt. The campaign highlights Himalayan climate influence on maturation, coinciding with 35.8% volume growth in premium segment.
